question: Triangle ABC is similar to Δ PQR and PQ = 10 cm, If the area of Δ ABC is 32 cm² and the area of Δ PQR is 50 cm². then the length of AB (in cm) is equal to:
solution:
**Given:**

Δ ABC is similar to Δ PQR

PQ = 10 cm

Area of Δ ABC = 32 cm²

Area of Δ PQR = 50 cm²

**Concept used:**

If two triangles are similar then the ratio of their corresponding sides, perpendicular, Median and square root of their area will be equal

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/181470cd7c5d0b9d1e470a3c1eae81130d587d4d6eaeaf514f503eac09dad134.png] 

⇒ AB / PQ = √(32 / 50) = √(16 / 25)

⇒ AB / 10 = 4 / 5

⇒ AB = (4 / 5) × 10 = 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**
